name: Virtualized Tree
summary: A tree so large that the browser is asked to lay out only the branches near the reader. Every branch is still a disclosure, so the browser opens and closes it and the state survives a reload.
summaryZh: 一棵大到只需要浏览器排版靠近读者的那些分支的树。每一支仍然是展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责,展开的状态也能扛过一次刷新。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The levels are held apart by indentation alone. The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: With guides
variants.note: A rule runs down the side of each level, so the depth of a branch can be seen rather than counted.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The label takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The label takes the title size.

states.name: Open
states.note: The branch is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the label, because the label is what the reader is on.

states.name: Highlight current
states.note: The tree is told to mark the branch the reader is on.

states.name: Scrollbar always on
states.note: The scrolling box keeps its scrollbar whether the tree needs one or not.

states.name: Current node
states.note: The branch the reader is on. It takes the highlight fill when the tree highlights the current branch.

states.name: Empty
states.note: The tree holds nothing: there is no branch to read.

parts.name: Scroller
parts.note: The box that scrolls. It carries the overflow and the surface, and the host gives it a height, because a box that is not given one never scrolls.

parts.name: Tree
parts.note: The branches. It is a group, so the branches are read as one thing.

parts.name: Node
parts.note: One branch. It is a <details>, so it is the element that knows whether it is open.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The summary. It is the element the browser turns into a disclosure button, so it carries the focus and the keyboard.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The name of the thing the branch holds.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the branch holds something. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Children
parts.note: The level below. The branches in it carry the skip: a branch far from the viewport is not laid out, and it holds a placeholder size until it comes near.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the guide lines between the levels are drawn.
props.descriptionZh: 层级之间的引导线画不画。

props.name: size
props.description: How tall a branch is and how big the type in it is.
props.descriptionZh: 分支有多高,里面的字有多大。

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the tree goes. The wrapper writes that many levels of branches.
props.descriptionZh: 这棵树有多深。包装器照这个层数写分支。

props.name: branches
props.description: How many branches each level has. The wrapper multiplies them out, so a depth of four and six branches is a thousand leaves. No branches at all is an empty tree, and the empty slot says what it holds.
props.descriptionZh: 每一层有几支。包装器把它们乘出来,四层配六支就是一千多个叶子。一支也没有就是空树,空插槽说它装着什么。

props.name: height
props.description: How tall the scrolling box is. The library cannot guess it: a box that is not given a height never scrolls, because its content is what gives it one.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区有多高。库猜不出来:没给高度的盒子不会滚,因为给它高度的是它自己的内容。

props.name: highlight-current
props.description: Whether the branch the reader is on takes the highlight fill. That branch is marked with um-virtual-tree__node--current.
props.descriptionZh: 读者所在的那一支是否带上高亮底色。那一支自己用 um-virtual-tree__node--current 标记。

props.name: scrollbar-always-on
props.description: Whether the scrolling box keeps its scrollbar whether the tree needs one or not, so the branches do not move sideways as the tree grows. It adds um-virtual-tree--scrollbar-always-on.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区是否一直留着滚动条,不管这棵树用不用得上,这样树变长时分支不会横向挪动。它加上 um-virtual-tree--scrollbar-always-on。

slots.name: default
slots.description: What one branch says. It is given the path to the branch and the level it is on. The arrow stays: it is the mark that says the branch holds something.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一支写什么。它拿到这一支的路径和它所在的层。那个箭头还在:它是说明这一支里还有东西的记号。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What the tree says when it holds nothing at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 这棵树什么都没有的时候说什么。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when a branch opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某一支展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: Every branch is a real <details> and every label is a real <summary>, so the browser announces each label as a disclosure button and says whether its branch is open. The keyboard is the browser's own: Tab reaches the labels, Enter or Space opens the branch. The arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text — the state is announced by the browser, not by the mark. The tree role is not used on purpose: it promises tree items and arrow-key navigation, and a tree of disclosures does not deliver either. The scrolling box is a real element with overflow on it and a tabindex, so it can be reached with Tab and scrolled with the arrow keys, the page keys and Home and End.
a11y.notesZh: 每一支都是真正的 <details>,每一个标签都是真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把每个标签播报成展开按钮,并说明它那一支是开着还是关着。键盘也是浏览器自己的:Tab 走到标签上,Enter 或空格展开那一支。那个箭头是边框画出来的,所以它自己不带文字 —— 状态是浏览器播报的,不是那个记号播报的。这里刻意不用 tree 这个角色:它承诺的是树节点和方向键导航,而一棵由展开控件组成的树两者都给不了。滚动区是一个带 overflow、带 tabindex 的真元素,所以 Tab 能走到它,方向键、翻页键和 Home、End 都能滚它。

examples.title: A virtualized tree
examples.description: Four levels and forty-eight leaves in a box that is shorter than they are. The levels are held apart by indentation alone. A level far from the viewport is not laid out: the browser gives it a placeholder size until it comes near.
examples.descriptionZh: 四层、四十八个叶子,放在一个比它们矮的盒子里。各层只靠缩进区分。离视口远的那一层没有排版,浏览器先给它一个位置大小,等它靠近了再排。

notes: The skip happens on the branches themselves: each branch's children carry content-visibility: auto, so a branch far from the viewport costs a placeholder size instead of a layout. Skipping the level they sit in instead was measured and rejected: it reserves one branch's height for the whole level, so the list the reader can scroll comes to 2519px against a true 3680px and never catches up — 2906px after scrolling to the end. Skipping each child reserves its own height, so the level keeps its length: 3539px against the same 3680px, and 66 of the 72 branches were skipped. The placeholder is the label's own height, composed from the theme's gap rather than written as a number, so it is the same size as the branch it stands in for in every mood; the auto keyword in contain-intrinsic-size makes it the size the branch really had the last time it was laid out. The cost of that is the one every CSS-native virtualisation pays: the list is in the document, so the browser skips the layout and not the markup.
notesZh: 跳过发生在分支自己身上:每一支的子节点都带着 content-visibility: auto,所以离视口远的一支,代价是一个位置大小,而不是一次排版。改成跳过它们所在的那一层,量过之后否掉了:那样整层只占一个分支的高度,读者能滚的那份列表是 2519px,而真实长度是 3680px,而且永远追不上 —— 滚到底也才 2906px。改成每一支各自跳,各占各的高度,这一层就保住了长度:3539px,对着同一个 3680px,72 支里有 66 支被跳过。那个位置大小是标签自己的高度,用主题的间距算出来而不是写死一个数,所以在每一种 mood 里都和它代替的那一支一样大;contain-intrinsic-size 里的 auto 关键字会把它记成这一支上次真正排版时的高度。代价也是每一种用 CSS 做虚拟化都要付的:清单还在文档里,浏览器跳过的是排版,不是标记。
